name: Manipal Finance Corporation Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1984, Manipal Finance Corporation Ltd does recovery and repayment of its dues and debts.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
MFCL was engaged in the business of Hire Purchase and Lease finance. Previously, it was registered as the Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Financial 
Company, but its licence was cancelled 
by the RBI. The present activity of the company is restricted to the recovery of dues and repayment of debts.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
